test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

The secretary assures the audience that he/she is going to help them.

options.text: The secretary said to the audience, “I am going to help you.”
The secretary says to the audience, “I am going to help you.”
The secretary says to the audience, “I was going to help you.”
The secretary says to the audience, “I will be going to help you.”

solution:
The correct answer is **"The secretary says to the audience, “I am going to help you."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Ind**irect Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows: 
 
 
• The reported verb is in the present tense, therefore,** 'says'** will be used in the direct speech.
 
• The conjunction '**that**' is removed and inverted commas are added.
 
• The pronoun **'he/she' **changes to** 'I'.**
 
• The pronoun** 'them' **changes to** 'you'.**
 
• If the reporting verb is in the present tense or future tense, there will be no change in the tense/time/place of the reported speech.
 
• **'Am' **is used with first person singular pronoun. It is used with the pronoun, **'I'**.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb is in the present tense so, there will be no change in its reported speech.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**__**:** *The secretary says to the audience, “I am going to help you.”*
